correctness.rationale: At each finite b>=4,n>=1 the Fourier transform of the uniform three-digit tower factors as product of three-tap masks h_{b^j}(k)=|1+2cos(2pi k/b^j)|/3. For 3∤b the exact discrete one-level mask minimum occurs at 3k congruent ±1 modulo N=b^j (plus k=2 for N=4); inspected the proof comparison of the two nearest angular grid points, using strict concavity of G(delta) for N≡1 and H'(delta)<0 for N≡2. Because modular inverse classes for b^n reduce compatibly at every smaller level, both gaps simultaneously minimize every factor, and the last factor excludes all others. For 3|b, k=b/3 zeros the first mask. The normalized positive factor quotient is 1+O(b^{-j}) for fixed b, yielding a convergent positive C_b and a sharp O_b(b^{-n}) product remainder. Independently exhaustively evaluated the masks and every minimizing k for b=4,5,6,7,8,10,11,13 and n<=3 within N<=2000, confirming the exceptional (4,1) class, zero cases and formula. The all-base proof, not finite tests, establishes completeness.

originality.rationale: Dai–He–Lai (2012/13) treats exactly consecutive-digit Cantor measures and proves infinite orthogonal exponential classification (Theorem 2.1), and writes the same Dirichlet sine mask (Eq. 2.2). Its full original manuscript was independently inspected: the theorem does not give the finite-stage minimum of |νhat| or modular-optimal residue set. Fu–Wang (2026) treats same digit family in a qualitative infinite-frame absence theorem; its abstract and synopsis are narrower, but full text not directly obtained here. The sharp Resultary binary two-digit Cantor coherence uses a two-tap cosine mask and 4k congruence, not the three-tap 3k case. Best-of-knowledge finite-stage optimum remains not implied by the checked sources.
residual_risks: A pre-2012 trigonometric/number-theoretic three-tap minimum lemma could be equivalent to this finite-stage statement, unindexed.
The 2026 Fu–Wang full manuscript was not independently read, leaving an explicit source-access/priority limitation, not automatic scientific failure.

value.rationale: Finite cylinder measures for natural Cantor fractals have intrinsic Gram conditioning of pairs of integer exponentials. Exact divisibility-zero versus strictly positive superexponential near-orthogonality, every optimal residue and the sharp depth scale are precise useful calibration facts, distinct from the known qualitative infinite spectrality obstruction.

limitations: Finite equal-weight digits {0,1,2}, integer b>=4, levels n>=1 and pairs of integer-frequency characters only; no assertion on multi-character Fourier frames or infinite spanning systems.
Finite brute force only tests selected cases, while all-base exactness relies on the trigonometric modular argument.
